title: TikTok MSO
summary: This note covers TikTok's monetization methods, strengths, and the owner's interest in the Monetization Strategy & Ops team. It details how TikTok monetizes through various streams and aligns with the owner's background in driving revenue and operational efficiency.

key_points.text: TikTok Monetization: TikTok has four main revenue streams: advertising, TikTok Shop, brand partnerships, and virtual gifts.
TikTok Strengths: Algorithm -> Organic, Natural, Ads feel authentic + Tiktok Shop -> Seamless experience + AI driven content and ad creation and management
Owner's Interest: I want to work in MSO because I love working on monetization, revenue and really increasing bottom line revenue for my products.
Past Experience: Almost every project that I worked on at Otis was sold at cost, 0% margin, and it was up to me to turn this ship around and hit my profit goals of 5-10%.

Team Alignment: The team’s focus on understanding revenue trends, optimizing ad effectiveness, and launching new monetization models aligns perfectly with my background, which is combining execution skills from project management with an analytical, data-driven mindset
